name: Survodutide
subtitle: GLP-1/glucagon dual agonist
summary: Late-stage dual agonist adding glucagon-driven energy burn to GLP-1 satiety.
caveat: Late-stage but not approved; GI side effects led a notable share of trial participants to stop.
